definitions.explanation: A woman on her wedding day or about to be married.
A married woman (from the perspective of her husband or his family).

examples.english: To get married (said of a woman).
examples.notes: 嫁に行く = to marry into another family

examples.english: The day has come to send our daughter off as a bride.
examples.notes: 嫁に出す = to send one's daughter off in marriage

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{嫁|よめ}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She is planning to become a bride next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、「⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{嫁|よめ}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When she was little, she used to say, 'I want to be a bride when I grow up.'

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嫁|よめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My wife is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嫁|よめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: My son's wife is coming next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嫁|よめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I took her as my wife.
examples.notes: 嫁にもらう = to take as a wife (traditional expression)

examples.english: The relationship between a daughter-in-law and her mother-in-law sometimes doesn't go well.
examples.notes: 嫁と姑 = wife and mother-in-law (common topic in Japanese culture)

examples.english: He likes to brag about his wife to his friends.

notes:
USAGE: {嫁|よめ} can mean (1) bride, (2) wife (casual/informal), or (3) daughter-in-law. The meaning depends on context and the speaker's perspective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嫁|よめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to get married - for women)
- {嫁|よめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to take as a wife)
- {嫁|よめ}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧ (wife - casual/affectionate)
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{嫁|よめ}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧ (bride)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{花嫁|はなよめ}→花嫁：04318_hanayome⟧ - bride (at wedding)
- ⟦{婿|むこ}→婿：10617_muko⟧ - groom, son-in-law
- ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ - wife (formal)
